ArtifactMetadata.Summary: Comprehensive implementation plan to migrate the entire Ctrl Center codebase from Tailwind CSS v4 to standard/vanilla CSS. Covers 17 JSX component files across 3 layers: build config removal, global CSS conversion, and per-component CSS file creation. The migration is a 1:1 visual translation — no design changes, just moving from Tailwind utility classes to semantic CSS class names with dedicated .css files per component.

args.CodeContent:
# Migrate Codebase from Tailwind CSS to Standard CSS

Remove Tailwind CSS entirely and replace all inline Tailwind utility classes with equivalent vanilla CSS using component-scoped CSS files.

## Scope Analysis

The project uses **Tailwind CSS v4** with the `@tailwindcss/vite` plugin. Tailwind is used in two ways:

1. **`@theme` / `@variant` / `@layer utilities`** directives in [index.css](file:///Users/koushikmandal/Desktop/code%20with%20care/ctrl%20center/ctrl_center_1/src/index.css) — custom design tokens and utility classes
2. **Inline Tailwind utility classes** (`className="flex items-center p-4 ..."`) in all **17 JSX component files** plus [index.html](file:///Users/koushikmandal/Desktop/code%20with%20care/ctrl%20center/ctrl_center_1/index.html)

Two components already use dedicated CSS files: [LaunchTile.css](file:///Users/koushikmandal/Desktop/code%20with%20care/ctrl%20center/ctrl_center_1/src/components/LaunchTile.css) and [ShortcutBar.css](file:///Users/koushikmandal/Desktop/code%20with%20care/ctrl%20center/ctrl_center_1/src/components/ShortcutBar.css) — these will be kept and are already Tailwind-free.

## Proposed Changes

### Build Configuration

#### [MODIFY] [package.json](file:///Users/koushikmandal/Desktop/code%20with%20care/ctrl%20center/ctrl_center_1/package.json)
- Remove `tailwindcss` and `@tailwindcss/vite` from `devDependencies`

#### [MODIFY] [vite.config.js](file:///Users/koushikmandal/Desktop/code%20with%20care/ctrl%20center/ctrl_center_1/vite.config.js)
- Remove the `import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite'` import
- Remove `tailwindcss()` from the `plugins` array

---

### Global Styles

#### [MODIFY] [index.css](file:///Users/koushikmandal/Desktop/code%20with%20care/ctrl%20center/ctrl_center_1/src/index.css)
- Remove `@import "tailwindcss"` directive
- Remove `@variant dark(...)` directive  
- Convert `@theme { ... }` block to standard CSS custom properties in `:root`
- Convert `@layer utilities { ... }` classes to standard CSS classes
- Add a **CSS reset/normalize** section to replace Tailwind's preflight (box-sizing, margin reset, etc.)
- Add standard font family definitions to replace Tailwind's `font-sans`, `font-mono`, `font-heading`

#### [MODIFY] [index.html](file:///Users/koushikmandal/Desktop/code%20with%20care/ctrl%20center/ctrl_center_1/index.html)
- Replace `class="antialiased selection:bg-[#F25C23] selection:text-white min-h-screen"` on `<body>` with standard CSS classes defined in `index.css`

---

### Component CSS Files (13 NEW files)

Each component that currently uses inline Tailwind classes will get a dedicated `.css` file. All Tailwind utility classes will be translated into semantic CSS class names. The corresponding JSX will be updated to use these class names instead.

#### [NEW] `AppShell.css` — for [AppShell.jsx](file:///Users/koushikmandal/Desktop/code%20with%20care/ctrl%20center/ctrl_center_1/src/components/AppShell.jsx) (~625 lines of JSX with heavy Tailwind usage)
#### [MODIFY] `AppShell.jsx` — replace all Tailwind `className` strings with semantic CSS classes

#### [NEW] `TopNavigation.css` — for [TopNavigation.jsx](file:///Users/koushikmandal/Desktop/code%20with%20care/ctrl%20center/ctrl_center_1/src/components/TopNavigation.jsx)
#### [MODIFY] `TopNavigation.jsx` — replace all Tailwind classes

#### [NEW] `QuickLaunch.css` — for [QuickLaunch.jsx](file:///Users/koushikmandal/Desktop/code%20with%20care/ctrl%20center/ctrl_center_1/src/components/QuickLaunch.jsx)
#### [MODIFY] `QuickLaunch.jsx` — replace all Tailwind classes

#### [NEW] `PrivateVault.css` — for [PrivateVault.jsx](file:///Users/koushikmandal/Desktop/code%20with%20care/ctrl%20center/ctrl_center_1/src/components/PrivateVault.jsx)
#### [MODIFY] `PrivateVault.jsx` — replace all Tailwind classes

#### [NEW] `PlaylistPanel.css` — for [PlaylistPanel.jsx](file:///Users/koushikmandal/Desktop/code%20with%20care/ctrl%20center/ctrl_center_1/src/components/PlaylistPanel.jsx) (~1170 lines — the largest component)
#### [MODIFY] `PlaylistPanel.jsx` — replace all Tailwind classes

#### [NEW] `ToolsWorkspace.css` — for [ToolsWorkspace.jsx](file:///Users/koushikmandal/Desktop/code%20with%20care/ctrl%20center/ctrl_center_1/src/components/ToolsWorkspace.jsx)

#### Modal Components:

#### [MODIFY] `AddPlaylistModal.jsx`

#### [NEW] `modals/AddToolModal.css` — for [AddToolModal.jsx](file:///Users/koushikmandal/Desktop/code%20with%20care/ctrl%20center/ctrl_center_1/src/components/modals/AddToolModal.jsx)
#### [MODIFY] `AddToolModal.jsx`

#### [NEW] `modals/QuickActionMenu.css` — for [QuickActionMenu.jsx](file:///Users/koushikmandal/Desktop/code%20with%20care/ctrl%20center/ctrl_center_1/src/components/modals/QuickActionMenu.jsx)
#### [MODIFY] `QuickActionMenu.jsx`

#### [NEW] `modals/SearchModal.css` — for [SearchModal.jsx](file:///Users/koushikmandal/Desktop/code%20with%20care/ctrl%20center/ctrl_center_1/src/components/modals/SearchModal.jsx)
#### [MODIFY] `SearchModal.jsx`

#### [NEW] `modals/ShortcutsModal.css` — for [ShortcutsModal.jsx](file:///Users/koushikmandal/Desktop/code%20with%20care/ctrl%20center/ctrl_center_1/src/components/modals/ShortcutsModal.jsx)
#### [MODIFY] `ShortcutsModal.jsx`

#### [NEW] `modals/VaultModal.css` — for [VaultModal.jsx](file:///Users/koushikmandal/Desktop/code%20with%20care/ctrl%20center/ctrl_center_1/src/components/modals/VaultModal.jsx) (~856 lines — second largest)
#### [MODIFY] `VaultModal.jsx`

---

### Existing CSS Files (KEEP)

#### [KEEP] [LaunchTile.css](file:///Users/koushikmandal/Desktop/code%20with%20care/ctrl%20center/ctrl_center_1/src/components/LaunchTile.css) — Already uses standard CSS
#### [KEEP] [ShortcutBar.css](file:///Users/koushikmandal/Desktop/code%20with%20care/ctrl%20center/ctrl_center_1/src/components/ShortcutBar.css) — Already uses standard CSS

---

### Cleanup

#### Post-migration:
- Run `npm uninstall tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite` to remove packages
- Delete `node_modules` and re-run `npm install` for a clean install
- Remove stale `bun.lock` tailwind references (auto-handled on next `bun install`)

---

## Migration Strategy

The approach for converting each component is:

1. **Create a `.css` file** with semantic class names (e.g., `.app-shell`, `.app-shell-main`, `.bento-section`)
2. **Map each Tailwind class** to its CSS equivalent (e.g., `flex items-center gap-2` → `display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;`)
3. **Handle dark mode** via `.dark` parent selector (matching the existing `html.dark` / `ThemeContext` pattern), e.g., `.dark .app-shell { ... }`
4. **Handle responsive breakpoints** via standard `@media` queries mapping Tailwind's `sm:` (640px), `md:` (768px), `lg:` (1024px), `xl:` (1280px)
5. **Preserve all dynamic className logic** where `isDark` ternaries are used — convert to a `.theme-dark` / `.theme-light` class pattern that the component already partially uses (like LaunchTile)
6. **Replace Tailwind animation classes** (like `animate-pulse`, `animate-spin`, `animate-ping`) with `@keyframes` definitions in the CSS files
7. **Import the CSS file** from each component's JSX

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **No visual changes intended.** The migration is a 1:1 translation — the app should look and behave identically after the migration. All colors, spacings, shadows, animations, dark/light mode behavior, and responsive breakpoints will be preserved.

## Verification Plan

### Automated Tests
```bash
npm run build
```
A successful production build confirms no Tailwind references remain and all CSS is valid.

### Manual Verification
- Run `npm run dev` and visually compare the dashboard in both light and dark modes
- Test all responsive breakpoints (mobile, tablet, desktop)
- Verify all modals open/close correctly
- Confirm keyboard shortcuts still work
- Verify the Tailwind packages are fully removed from `package.json` and `node_modules`

### Automated Verification
```bash
grep -r "tailwind" src/ --include="*.jsx" --include="*.css" --include="*.js"
```
Should return zero results after migration.
